token_count_scope: Pinned Gemma native tokenizer, message content only; full MS-SWIFT template verification is still mandatory.
limitations: AI-authored candidate answers are not human-verified gold.
Direction labels describe the intended task, not independently demonstrated reasoning validity.
Chapter/file and DOI family isolation does not mean entire books or software repositories are held out.
Real source windows preserve repeated framework examples already in the source; no text was duplicated to pad length.
This is a reduced pilot, not the full 128/32 design; task proportions are reported rather than forced.
